observations.stage: fresh merged-main source and package evaluation
observations.observation: The first post-evaluation trace-verifier wrapper omitted the repository src directory from PYTHONPATH and stopped on import before evaluating either immutable report or trace.
observations.successor: The corrected wrapper supplied the exact source path; both 261-event traces passed chain and endpoint-anchor verification without changing the reports or traces.

observations.observation: The first MCP wrapper set only the child runtime selector and omitted the verifier process import path, so the verifier failed before MCP startup.
observations.successor: The corrected wrapper supplied src to the verifier and separately selected src or the exact zipapp for the child runtime. Both paths exposed the same three no-authority tools and passed anchored telemetry checks.

observations.observation: A PowerShell wrapper attempted to call SequenceEqual as an instance method on byte arrays after independently displaying equal lengths and SHA-256 values; that method is unavailable in the invoked form.
observations.successor: An exact length plus SHA-256 comparison proved the two contract files byte-identical. No contract byte changed.

observations.observation: Running scripts/verify_live_api.ps1 under PowerShell 7 passed 129 of 131 checks. Only the missing- and wrong-capability WWW-Authenticate observations were null when read through HttpResponseMessage.Headers['WWW-Authenticate']; HTTP 401 handling and all other API, policy, approval, executor, idempotency, replay, postcondition, state, telemetry, and dashboard checks passed.
observations.server_evidence: The server emits Sentinel-Capability realm="runbook-sentinel-operator" and the independent urllib unit surface observes it exactly.
observations.successor: The same unchanged script and server run under the project's validated Windows PowerShell runtime passed 131 of 131 checks with both challenges exact.
observations.claim_boundary: The release supports the validated Windows PowerShell verification path. It does not claim that this header-observation wrapper is portable to PowerShell 7.

observations.observation: A first batched image-view request exceeded the viewer output context and yielded no admissible inspection result.
observations.successor: The unchanged source, package, and container PNG bytes were inspected one at a time at original detail and each complete frame passed.

observations.observation: A read-only PowerShell foreach result was piped without an array wrapper and stopped at parser validation.
observations.successor: The corrected array-wrapped inspection read the immutable BASELINE-0029 receipt and changed no project or evidence byte.

release_effect: None of these observations is positive release evidence. The selected corrected successors are independently bound in merged-main-baseline-0030.json. The PowerShell 7 item remains an explicit compatibility limitation; no verifier, security boundary, runtime, package, model, or release claim was weakened.
